title: [codex] fix read-query exposure safeguards
body:
## Summary
- default MCP HTTP binding to loopback instead of all interfaces
- fail closed when HTTP is bound to a non-loopback host without OAuth enabled
- enforce parser-backed, single-statement read-only SQL validation in PinotClient with sqlglot before forwarding read-query SQL to Pinot
- make Helm defaults local-only with no Service, and require OAuth for any non-loopback Kubernetes exposure
- add SECURITY.md with vulnerability reporting instructions, security categories, and an HTTP exposure checklist
- remove the stale PR_DESCRIPTION.md helper file; the GitHub PR body is now the canonical change summary
- update README, user guide, docs site, changelog, env example, and Helm guidance with secure exposure notes and example read-only query behavior

## Root Cause
Issue #90 and [GHSA-73cv-556c-w3g6](https://github.com/startreedata/mcp-pinot/security/advisories/GHSA-73cv-556c-w3g6) were valid: the server defaulted to unauthenticated HTTP on 0.0.0.0, and read-query only checked that input started with SELECT. That left network exposure too broad by default and made stacked/comment-obfuscated SQL possible before Pinot saw the query.

## User Impact
By default, local HTTP now listens on 127.0.0.1. If users intentionally configure MCP_HOST=0.0.0.0, the server now refuses to start unless OAUTH_ENABLED=true. Helm defaults render local-only without a Service; enabling Service/Traefik/HTTP probes requires a non-loopback host, and any non-loopback host requires OAuth. read-query now accepts one valid SELECT or WITH ... SELECT statement, rejects stacked statements and write/DDL/admin keywords, and keeps Pinot trailing OPTION(...) clauses working. SECURITY.md documents vulnerability reporting, security categories, and the checklist for safely exposing HTTP.

## Validation
- uv lock --check
- uv run pytest
- uv run pytest tests/test_pinot_client.py -q
- uv run ruff check mcp_pinot mcp_pinot_ops tests
- uv run ruff format --check mcp_pinot mcp_pinot_ops tests
- helm lint helm/mcp-pinot
- helm template default renders no Service
- helm template rejects Service/Traefik/HTTP health checks with loopback host
- helm template rejects non-loopback host without OAuth
- helm template renders Service when service.enabled=true, mcp.host=0.0.0.0, and mcp.oauth.enabled=true
- git diff --check

Fixes #90
Addresses [GHSA-73cv-556c-w3g6](https://github.com/startreedata/mcp-pinot/security/advisories/GHSA-73cv-556c-w3g6)
